sup:70140.text:
Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are very excited about the opportunity to work together with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and to prove ourselves as a reliable partner for your business!

For our offer, we can propose a price of €47.00 per unit, alongside a quality commitment of 6400 ppm. 

Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days. We are eager to show you what we can do and hope this initial quote meets your expectations. Let us know if you have any questions at all.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

move.subject: Re: Quote from Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
move.body:
Dear Marek Lis,

Thank you for your quote and your willingness to demonstrate reliability. Predictable financial exposure matters during your restructuring, and we acknowledge that our payment delays have added pressure, but your proposed quality commitment falls short of the recovery needed.

Your defect rate over the last four quarters stands at 2376 ppm (sc:70140@2026Q3).

We are flexible on the quality commitment: tighter defect control earns a higher price, while every option removes complaint chargebacks to address your concern about financial exposure. Which quality and price pairing works best for you?

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 43.78 per unit, quality commitment 300 ppm, EUR 0 chargeback per complaint.
Option B: EUR 43.55 per unit, quality commitment 800 ppm, EUR 0 chargeback per complaint.
Option C: EUR 43.24 per unit, quality commitment 1500 ppm, EUR 0 chargeback per complaint.

We value our relationship and want these terms to support measurable quality improvement and dependable deliveries.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We see your figures, but we cannot give up margin right now. Faster payment would help us more than anything. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. 

Thanks for the options. We can agree to the 1500 ppm quality commitment and 0 EUR chargeback to show we are serious about improving. Our main Angebot provides a price of €46.50 per unit, a quality commitment of 300 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. Alternatively, with a quality commitment of 1500 ppm: €46.00 per unit. We can offer 46.00 EUR for this package, which helps us keep things running smoothly. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 60 days net. 

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

move.subject: Re: Quote from Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
move.body:
Dear Marek Lis,

Thank you for improving your price offer and confirming your quality commitment. We understand that faster payment matters most and that you need to protect margins; we also acknowledge that our payment delays have added pressure.

We have made a modest price step and are flexible on complaint chargebacks: Option B removes them as requested, giving you predictable complaint exposure in exchange for a lower price. Which chargeback and price pairing works best for you, recognising that our concession needs a reciprocal price step?

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 44.44 per unit, EUR 500 chargeback per complaint, quality commitment 300 ppm.
Option B: EUR 44.30 per unit, EUR 0 chargeback per complaint, quality commitment 300 ppm.
Option C: EUR 44.34 per unit, EUR 150 chargeback per complaint, quality commitment 300 ppm.

We value our relationship and want this agreement to support measurable recovery in both quality and delivery.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

We can drop the price to 46.00 EUR for this package. So, our offer is a price of €46.00 per unit, a quality commitment of 300 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. Thanks for the options, we definitely prefer the 0 EUR chargeback to keep things predictable.
